A '''bank''' operated in [[Daiyu City]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]]. A [[Color|white]] and pink sign written in [[Aurebesh]] was used to attract potential customers; it read "BANK", with the [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] symbol at the beginning and the end symbolizing [[Currency|money]].<ref name="Kenobi" />
